name: get_email
description: Background scheduler tool that ingests inbox emails into the runtime EventRepository. Not intended for agent triage — use get_important_emails for that. Returns raw (unsummarized) email records. Range is capped at 7 days lookback.

inputs.name: repo_update
inputs.description: Internal scheduler flag. When true, stores all fetched emails in EventRepository without LLM filtering. Always set to true by the background scheduler. Agents should not set this.

outputs.description: Filtered/summarized email list. Bodies/headers are not guaranteed to be complete. Use get_email_thread for full thread/body retrieval.

arguments_prompt: This is an internal background scheduler tool. Agents should use get_important_emails for inbox triage, or get_email_messages for query-driven search.

metadata.planner_description: Internal scheduler ingest — agents should prefer get_important_emails or get_email_messages.
